name: I Counter Left
purpose: Misdirection off the toss. We show them the toss to the flanker side, their linebackers chase, and the tailback plants and comes back weak behind a pulling guard.

RTE.rule: Cut off pursuit from behind. You are the last one to the ball, so never quit on the play.

RT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you — nobody crosses your face.

RG.rule: PULL LEFT. Stay flat behind the line and kick out the end on the other side.

C.rule: You have the nose, head up on you. Hands inside and do not let him cross your face to the playside.

LG.rule: Nobody is over you. Help the center drive the nose for one count, then climb to the middle linebacker.

LT.rule: The tackle is on your inside shoulder. Block him down and seal him inside — that is what opens the hole.

LTE.rule: Release inside off his outside shoulder and take the playside linebacker. The end over you is being kicked out — leave him alone.

Z.rule: Take one hard step upfield like the toss is coming, then come back and cut off the backside.

QB.rule: Take the snap, fake the toss the other way with both hands, then turn back and hand to the tailback. The fake comes first — the handoff is late on purpose.

FB.rule: Run the toss path to the other side at full speed and block anything that shows. You are the lie.

TB.rule: Take two hard steps toward the toss, then plant and come back behind the pulling guard. Those two steps are the entire play.

coaching_points: Do not call this until I Toss Right has gone for real yards. Misdirection off a play they do not fear is just a slower run.
The tailback's counter steps must be full speed and full length. A shuffle fools nobody.
The fullback selling the toss matters more than his block. Tell him he is the decoy and mean it.
If their backside linebacker stops chasing the toss, go back to I Slant Left.
